name: ask
description: 向用户提问并阻塞等待回复。当需要澄清、决策或仅用户能提供的信息时使用。可在一次调用里提出多个问题（questions 数组，最多 6 题），前端会以向导卡片逐题呈现；也可用 question 单题兼容。每题支持回答类型：answerType="text" 自由文本（缺省）；"single" 单选（需提供 2-6 个 options）；"multi" 多选（需提供 options）；"boolean" 是/否；"form" 动态表单（需提供 formSchema）。可用 attachments 给出题面附件的绝对路径（前端渲染为附件卡片）。前端始终会附加「其他」自由输入项，用户可粘贴/选择文件作为回答附件，也可能取消提问。返回格式为「问题 + 用户回答（+ 附件路径）」，便于完整理解上下文。等待无默认超时。
description_en: Ask the user a question and block until the reply arrives. Use when you need clarification, a decision, or information only the user can provide. You may ask multiple questions in one call (questions array, up to 6); the frontend presents them as a wizard card. question is kept for single-question compatibility. Per-question answer types: answerType="text" free text (default); "single" single choice (requires 2-6 options); "multi" multiple choice (requires options); "boolean" yes/no; "form" dynamic form (requires formSchema). Use attachments to pass absolute paths of question-side files (rendered as attachment cards). The frontend always appends an "Other" free-input option; the user may attach pasted/selected files to the answer and may cancel. Returns a fixed "question + user answer (+ attachment paths)" format for full context. No default timeout while waiting.

id.description: 问题标识（可选，缺省按顺序生成 q0/q1…）
id.description_en: Question identifier (optional; defaults to q0/q1… in order)

question.description: 要向用户提问的问题。请具体且简洁。
question.description_en: The question to ask the user. Be specific and concise.

answerType.description: 回答类型。text=自由文本（缺省）；single=单选；multi=多选；boolean=是/否；form=动态表单
answerType.description_en: Answer type. text=free text (default); single=single choice; multi=multiple choice; boolean=yes/no; form=dynamic form

description.description: 选项补充说明（可选，显示在选项下方的小字）
description.description_en: Optional option description (shown as small text under the option)

options.description: 候选项列表。answerType 为 single/multi 时必填（2-6 项）；前端会自动附加「其他」自由输入项
options.description_en: List of candidate options. Required when answerType is single/multi (2-6 items); the frontend automatically appends an "Other" free-input option

defaultAnswer.description: 预填的默认回答文本（可选，仅 text 类型）
defaultAnswer.description_en: Pre-filled default answer text (optional, text type only)

formSchema.description: answerType=form 时的 JSON Schema（顶层 properties：string/number/boolean）
formSchema.description_en: JSON Schema when answerType=form (top-level properties: string/number/boolean)

attachments.description: 题面附件的文件绝对路径（可选，前端渲染为附件卡片并可预览）
attachments.description_en: Absolute file paths of question-side attachments (optional; rendered as attachment cards with preview)

questions.description: 一次提问的多个问题（最多 6 题）。与 question 二选一，优先使用本数组。
questions.description_en: Multiple questions in one call (max 6). Mutually exclusive with question; this array takes precedence.

question.description: 【单题兼容用法】要向用户提问的问题。多题请改用 questions 数组。
question.description_en: [Single-question compatibility] The question to ask. Use the questions array for multiple questions.

answerType.description: 【单题兼容用法】回答类型。text=自由文本（缺省）；single=单选；multi=多选；boolean=是/否
answerType.description_en: [Single-question compatibility] Answer type. text=free text (default); single=single choice; multi=multiple choice; boolean=yes/no

options.description: 【单题兼容用法】候选项列表（answerType 为 single/multi 时必填，2-6 项）
options.description_en: [Single-question compatibility] Candidate options (required for single/multi, 2-6 items)

defaultAnswer.description: 【单题兼容用法】预填的默认回答文本（可选，仅 text 类型）
defaultAnswer.description_en: [Single-question compatibility] Pre-filled default answer text (optional, text type only)

attachments.description: 【单题兼容用法】题面附件的文件绝对路径（可选）
attachments.description_en: [Single-question compatibility] Absolute file paths of question-side attachments (optional)
